A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ALMC research work. The main text, equations, figures, and Appendices A–D can be matched reliably; v3 adds Appendix E. No material reading gaps prevent comparison.

before.justification: Figure 4 and Remark 4.7 report original ALMC simulation outcomes for a vertical-bars prior, including sampled densities and reduced weights for measurement-inconsistent modes.

after.justification: V3 retains Figure 4 and adds original synthetic sampling results and a measurement-noise sensitivity study in Appendix E, Figures 8, 10, and 11.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 retains the same Gaussian initialization, likelihood-based LMC warm start, and annealed updates targeting posteriors of progressively denoised priors. The revised theoretical parameter prescriptions do not introduce a new update rule or method component.

E1.justification: Empirical coverage expands from the vertical-bars illustration to include five-component Gaussian-mixture and two-moons priors. Appendix E also evaluates full-vector noisy measurements alongside coordinate projections, substantially broadening the tested prior structures and measurement requirements.

E2.justification: Neither version empirically evaluates a comparison algorithm against ALMC. The new Appendix E simulations show Algorithm 1 alone; other sampling methods remain discussed or cited.

E3.justification: The added simulations introduce a fixed protocol with kappa=400, 200 noising levels, and 10,000 samples per plotted sampler; Figure 10 specifies 80,000 iterations. These are settings for new experiments, with no documented protocol revision to the retained Figure 4 experiment.

E4.justification: Figure 11 adds a measurement-noise sensitivity study with four likelihood/sampler pairs for the vertical-bars prior, examining changes in sampled mass around gapped bars. V2 has no corresponding empirical noise sweep.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. V3's 10,000 generated samples per plot are sample sizes, not repeated-run or uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Figures 8 and 10 add sampled posterior distributions for three priors under two measurement models, while Figure 11 adds noise-dependent sampling outcomes, including persistent mass in gapped bars. These substantially extend the original qualitative evidence. Figure 4 itself retains the same results; no same-setting numerical performance improvement is reported.

T1.justification: Lemma 4.3 changes the reported warm-start dimension factor from d^3 to d. Appendix B substantially revises the continuity, FI, and KL arguments: it adds a uniformity argument, replaces an averaged-law argument with selection of an interpolated time, changes alpha from 3/4 to 17/20, and revises rate derivations. Corollary 4.1 replaces unspecified polynomial bounds with explicit rates, although statements and proofs contain unresolved discrepancies.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claim: polynomial-time approximate posterior sampling with simultaneous KL proximity to the posterior of a noised prior and FI proximity to the true posterior. The novelty claim is unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations of FI as local mixing, KL as controlling mode weights, and computational hardness as limiting exact posterior sampling remain unchanged. Appendix E applies the existing mode-collapse interpretation to new simulations; its noise-sweep findings do not introduce a distinct mechanism explanation or limitation.

D1.justification: Appendix E adds concrete reproducibility information absent from v2's simulation description, including kappa, the number of noising levels, sample counts, and an iteration count. No code-access or hardware information is added.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. The new simulations introduce no additional citations or revised relationship to competing approaches.

P1.justification: V3 makes localized prose edits in Sections 2–4, revises theorem wording, and adds the short Appendix E narrative. Most paragraphs and the existing section organization remain unchanged; this is not an extensive language rewrite.

P2.justification: Figures 6–11 add a substantial multipanel visual presentation of priors, likelihoods, posterior samples, and noise sensitivity. Existing figures are retained, with Figure 4 resized and its caption reflowed.

improvement.justification: Appendix E improves on v2's single simulation illustration with broader examples and concrete settings. However, v3's revised central guarantees are inconsistent: Corollary 4.1 specifies delta=kappa^(1/4), versus kappa^(-1/4) in Theorems 4.4–4.5, and the revised FI proof ends with kappa^(-1/16) decay while Theorem 4.5 retains kappa^(-3/32). These unresolved discrepancies in the principal theoretical contribution prevent a reliable assessment of the net quality change.
